hypotheses.title: Time-Series Z-Score Acceleration Engine (Boilerplate 1)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Measures corporate cashflow efficiency acceleration relative to its trailing 20-day mean in units of historical standard deviation. Normalizes each stock against its own dynamic time-series baseline before cross-sectionally ranking peers. Eliminates the old signed_power transform to guarantee uniform weight distribution across all TOP3000 instruments with zero concentration penalties, and avoids short-term price reversal overlays to break self-correlation.
confounders: Low volatility regimes where ts_std_dev is artificially compressed
Infrequent balance sheet revisions for stagnant industry peers
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during macro liquidity crunches where operational efficiency metrics are overshadowed by broad market beta contagion.

hypotheses.title: Multiplicative Quality x Low-Beta Synergy (Boilerplate 2)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Implements soft logical conjunction: an asset receives top allocation only when exhibiting superior cash generation efficiency AND low market beta simultaneously. Multiplication produces natural non-linear convexity in the upper-right quadrant without squaring near-zero ranks, completely preserving capital allocation across the entire universe without weight concentration.
confounders: Speculative bull market rallies driven by high-beta cyclicals
Sector-wide credit downgrades hitting low-beta defensive names
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during rapid cyclical re-openings where distressed high-beta equities heavily outperform high-quality defensive peers.

hypotheses.title: Continuous Intra-Industry Z-Score Dispersion Spread (Boilerplate 3)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Preserves genuine economic distance and revision magnitude rather than flattening into uniform ranks. Standardizes analyst consensus revisions and market beta into bounded z-scores (clamped at +/- 2.5 to eliminate single-stock tail leverage) before forming an intra-industry spread. Wraps with final group_rank to ensure perfectly balanced long-short capital distribution.
confounders: Widely dispersed analyst revisions following unforeseen macroeconomic news
Beta estimation noise during regime transitions
hypotheses.falsification_test: Underperforms when analyst estimates cluster tightly around zero revision with negligible dispersion.
